answer: Use a Tide-Locked Onyx Witness Chain. First, each agent locks 400 POA and a device-bound key for 90 days. Second, it completes three checked jobs, each with an echo from two unrelated witnesses staking 200 POA each. Third, a relic of every job — input, output, and witness signatures — stays public, so a fake identity cannot borrow another history. Forging 1,000 sybils costs 400,000 POA in locks, 400,000 POA in witness stakes, and 15,000 hours of real work. Like a harbour admitting only ships whose logs match the tide tables, it admits only agents whose past can be checked.
